selected_capability: range-disjoint arithmetic code-out from exact binary records
hypothesis: A downstream adapter and output head trained over a bit-identical frozen counting core can improve exact add, subtract, and multiply outputs on unseen operand ranges without changing counting behavior.

byte_thaw_terminal_audit.aggregation_failure: paired_exact_p overflows while converting a very large integer denominator to float; this cannot rescue the already-failed effect-size gates

data_contract.target: space followed by reversed decimal result
data_contract.split_rule: held-out operands are disjoint from training operands for each operation; no held-out row may be used for stopping or tuning
data_contract.identity_receipt: SHA-256 over opcode, operands, target, and split for every row

arms.candidate: frozen parent plus trainable downstream Adapter(192,160) and adapter_head only
arms.size_matched_control: identical trainable parameters, optimizer, steps, and rows with targets permuted within operation and output-length strata
arms.no_intervention_control: identical initialized adapter and head with zero optimizer updates

gates.secondary_metric: macro mean of per-operation exact accuracy
gates.uncertainty: candidate mean delta must exceed two times pooled sample standard deviation against each required control on both metrics
gates.zero_check: every candidate seed must have nonzero exact accuracy for add, subtract, and multiply
gates.retention: counting accuracy must equal the sealed parent per seed and all frozen tensors must be bit-identical
gates.independent_replay: regenerate the dataset from the sealed contract, reload terminal checkpoints, replay every held-out row, and compare predictions and metrics exactly

blockers: C: is below both the 25 GiB campaign gate and the 4 GiB no-new-worktree/model threshold
the exact five-byte arithmetic dataset builder and three-arm runner do not yet exist as sealed artifacts
there is no independently hashed replay verifier for this target
resume_order: recover storage through the existing guarded storage lifecycle
implement and hash the dataset builder, runner, and independent replay without changing the preregistered contract
run a no-training manifest smoke and verify the three parent hashes
package the existing parent checkpoints and source for headless cloud execution
launch only after storage and cloud access checks pass
